name: conditionGrid
title: Responsive Image Grid
description: A responsive twelve-column project grid: two wide photos on top and two staggered below, each with a rounded image, a black title pill and a circular arrow link.
use: A portfolio or agency page needs a compact, editorial grid of project images.
avoid: The demo hardcodes four Unsplash photos and their titles, so real projects need a source edit.
a11y: Every image has the same generic alt text 'image' and the arrow is a decorative div, so screen readers get little meaning; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four photographs sit in a tight, offset grid on a white page: a tall black-shoe shot and a wide blue-lit sneaker shot above, a wide blue-toned shot and a narrower tan-boot shot below, each with rounded corners. Every tile carries a black rounded name pill at lower left and a black circular arrow at lower right.
behaves: Tiles slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport, revealing the photo and then its black overlay labels; the layout reflows from four uneven columns on desktop to stacked full-width tiles on small screens.
customise: Projects are a hardcoded array inside the file (image URL, title, description); add or edit entries there, and change column spans by editing the index rules in the code.
weight: light: Four images and a simple fade-slide animation; idle once they settle.
demo: Sneaker and boot product photos titled Distrokings, Profitables, Topserve-copiers and Labramart.
issues: All four images share the alt text 'image', which describes nothing.
The description field in each project is never displayed.
polishWhy: Crisp staggered grid and tidy labels; generic alt text and unused descriptions are misses.
